title: Disappearance of Los Alamos employee Melissa Casillas
place_text: Ranchos de Taos, New Mexico / Los Alamos National Laboratory

tellings.quote: Melissa Casillas is a 53-year-old administrative assistant at Los Alamos National Laboratory

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Melissa Casillas, a 53-year-old administrative assistant at Los Alamos National Laboratory, a US government research lab in New Mexico, who he says went missing in 2025 around Ranchos de Taos, New Mexico. He draws on her relatives Sierra and Mark Casillas and a GoFundMe, an online fundraising page, and he tells it as part of a wider question about why American scientists are going missing.
